description: This file defines a graph data structure and methods for managing relationships between Kubernetes API objects such as Pods, Nodes, PersistentVolumes, Secrets, and other resources. It includes classes for vertices and edges, and functions for adding, deleting, and updating graph nodes and edges, specifically tailored for Kubernetes resource relationships and authorization logic.

classes.name: namedVertex
classes.description: Represents a graph node with API object type, namespace, name, and ID.

classes.name: destinationEdge
classes.description: Graph edge with a denormalized reference to a destination vertex.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Manages Kubernetes resource relationships as a directed acyclic graph with thread-safe operations.

methods.name: newNamedVertex
methods.description: Creates a new namedVertex instance with specified type, namespace, name, and ID.

methods.name: NewGraph
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new Graph object.

methods.name: getOrCreateVertexLocked
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a vertex of a specific type, namespace, and name under a write lock.

methods.name: getVertexRLocked
methods.description: Retrieves a vertex of a specific type, namespace, and name under a read lock.

methods.name: createVertexLocked
methods.description: Creates a new vertex and adds it to the graph under a write lock.

methods.name: deleteVertexLocked
methods.description: Removes a vertex and associated edges from the graph under a write lock.

methods.name: deleteEdgesLocked
methods.description: Deletes edges from a specific source to a target vertex of given types.

methods.name: addEdgeLocked
methods.description: Adds an edge between two vertices, with optional destination, under a write lock.

methods.name: AddPod
methods.description: Adds a pod and its related resource edges to the graph.

methods.name: DeletePod
methods.description: Removes a pod and its edges from the graph.

methods.name: AddPodCertificateRequest
methods.description: Adds a PodCertificateRequest node and edge to the graph.

methods.name: DeletePodCertificateRequest
methods.description: Removes a PodCertificateRequest node from the graph.

methods.name: AddPV
methods.description: Adds a PersistentVolume and its related resource edges.

methods.name: DeletePV
methods.description: Removes a PersistentVolume from the graph.

methods.name: AddVolumeAttachment
methods.description: Adds a volume attachment node and its node relationship.

methods.name: AddResourceSlice
methods.description: Adds a resource slice node and its node relationship.
